note: Single source of the Board1 UART/CAN parameters. Edit here, then run python -B scripts/gen/gen_parameters.py; the quality gate fails on stale outputs.

parameters.name: rx-budget
parameters.brief: UART frames serviced per Foreground pass.

parameters.name: remote-current-cap
parameters.brief: Cap on remote current setpoints; never above the outer q-current limit (ID 73).

parameters.name: remote-position-cap
parameters.brief: Cap on remote position setpoints, rotor-side.

parameters.name: pole-pairs
parameters.brief: Pole pairs of the active commutation group.

parameters.name: electrical-offset
parameters.brief: Electrical offset of the valid commutation group; writable as a trim when on-MCU calibration is attached.

parameters.name: velocity-limit-ro
parameters.brief: Boot velocity limit of the position loop.

parameters.name: boot-configuration
parameters.brief: Startup configuration selected at boot.

parameters.name: calibration-input
parameters.brief: Startup calibration input.

parameters.name: calibration-rejection
parameters.brief: Why a startup calibration was rejected.

parameters.name: admission-failure
parameters.brief: Runtime admission failure of the boot configuration.

parameters.name: supply-id
parameters.brief: Read-only calibration supply identity.

parameters.name: review-id
parameters.brief: Calibration supply review identity.

parameters.name: phase-a-offset
parameters.brief: Phase A ADC zero in use.

parameters.name: phase-b-offset
parameters.brief: Phase B ADC zero in use.

parameters.name: phase-c-offset
parameters.brief: Phase C ADC zero in use.

parameters.name: encoder-cpr
parameters.brief: Encoder counts per revolution.

parameters.name: runtime-direction
parameters.brief: Runtime encoder direction: 0 none, 1 positive, 2 negative.

parameters.name: source-direction
parameters.brief: Encoder source direction code.

parameters.name: calibration-direction
parameters.brief: Calibration direction code.

parameters.name: measurement-qualified
parameters.brief: 1 when the current measurement is physically qualified (never in the locked image).

parameters.name: store-state
parameters.brief: Persistent settings state: 0 unavailable, 1 empty, 2 loaded, 3 invalid record, ...

parameters.name: store-loaded-sequence
parameters.brief: Sequence of the record loaded at boot.

parameters.name: store-stored-sequence
parameters.brief: Sequence of the newest stored record.

parameters.name: store-calibration
parameters.brief: 1 when a saved calibration was restored.

parameters.name: tuning-revision
parameters.brief: Revision of the applied controller tuning.

parameters.name: tuning-result
parameters.brief: Last tuning request: 0 none, 1 pending, 2 applied, 3 rejected, 4 cancelled.

parameters.name: tuning-sequence
parameters.brief: Sequence of the last tuning request.

parameters.name: current-kp-d
parameters.brief: Current-loop d proportional gain.

parameters.name: current-kp-q
parameters.brief: Current-loop q proportional gain.

parameters.name: current-ki-d
parameters.brief: Current-loop d integral gain.

parameters.name: current-ki-q
parameters.brief: Current-loop q integral gain.

parameters.name: current-limit
parameters.brief: Current-vector limit; the board ceiling bounds it.

parameters.name: velocity-kp
parameters.brief: Velocity-loop proportional gain.

parameters.name: velocity-ki
parameters.brief: Velocity-loop integral gain.

parameters.name: position-kp
parameters.brief: Position-loop proportional gain.

parameters.name: velocity-limit
parameters.brief: Speed reference limit, rotor-side.

parameters.name: iq-limit
parameters.brief: Outer q-current limit; at most the current-vector limit (ID 68).

parameters.name: command-lease-us
parameters.brief: Command lease; the default 2.5 ms stays, hosts raise it.

parameters.name: model-rs
parameters.brief: Phase resistance Rs.

parameters.name: model-ld
parameters.brief: d-axis inductance Ld.

parameters.name: model-lq
parameters.brief: q-axis inductance Lq.

parameters.name: model-flux
parameters.brief: Rotor flux linkage.

parameters.name: model-kt
parameters.brief: Kt = 1.5 x pole pairs x flux, per peak q ampere; 0 without a flux.

parameters.name: model-inertia
parameters.brief: Rotor inertia J.

parameters.name: model-damping
parameters.brief: Viscous damping B.

parameters.name: dead-time-comp
parameters.brief: Current-loop dead-time compensation; 0 (default) off, typically set to ID 95.

parameters.name: commutation-valid
parameters.brief: 1 when a commutation group is valid.

parameters.name: commutation-source
parameters.brief: Source of the commutation group.

parameters.name: adc-zero-state
parameters.brief: State of this boot's ADC zero measurement.

parameters.name: coast-status
parameters.brief: Coast check: 0 not run, 1 used, 2 too few, 3 inconsistent.

parameters.name: coast-flux
parameters.brief: Flux from the coast EMF.

parameters.name: coast-angle-error
parameters.brief: Electrical angle error from the coast EMF.

parameters.name: driven-flux
parameters.brief: Flux from the driven CAL-4 spin.

parameters.name: dead-time-v
parameters.brief: Inverter dead-time voltage identified by CAL-3.

parameters.name: rated-current
parameters.brief: Motor rated current; ID 68 keeps the board ceiling.

parameters.name: peak-current
parameters.brief: Motor peak current.

parameters.name: max-speed
parameters.brief: Motor maximum speed, rotor-side.

parameters.name: gear-ratio
parameters.brief: Rotor turns per output turn.

parameters.name: current-bandwidth
parameters.brief: Current-loop bandwidth for the derived PI.

parameters.name: accel
parameters.brief: Trajectory acceleration, rotor-side; 0 unlimited.

parameters.name: decel
parameters.brief: Trajectory deceleration, rotor-side; 0 unlimited.

parameters.name: velocity-bandwidth
parameters.brief: Velocity bandwidth for the J-derived outer gains; 0 keeps manual gains.

parameters.name: inertia-travel
parameters.brief: Rotor travel allowed to CAL-7.

parameters.name: trip-overcurrent
parameters.brief: Over-current trip; strictly above ID 68.

parameters.name: trip-overvoltage
parameters.brief: Bus over-voltage trip.

parameters.name: trip-undervoltage
parameters.brief: Bus under-voltage trip; below ID 113.

parameters.name: trip-overspeed
parameters.brief: Over-speed trip; 0 follows 1.25 x ID 72.

parameters.name: trip-sustained-ms
parameters.brief: Sustained over-current window.

parameters.name: trip-stall-ms
parameters.brief: Stall window.

parameters.name: trip-divergence-ms
parameters.brief: Following-error divergence window.

parameters.name: fet-temperature
parameters.brief: Filtered power-stage NTC temperature; NaN when off or without a reading.

parameters.name: can-node-id
parameters.brief: CANSimple node ID; 63 (0x3F) is unaddressed.

parameters.name: can-master-id
parameters.brief: MIT: CAN ID of the replies (the host's ID).

parameters.name: can-bitrate
parameters.brief: CAN bit rate in bit/s; applies at the next boot.

parameters.name: can-heartbeat-ms
parameters.brief: CAN heartbeat period; 0 off.

parameters.name: output-zero
parameters.brief: Output-position zero, output rad; host positions are relative to it.

parameters.name: can-estimates-ms
parameters.brief: CAN encoder-estimate period; 0 off.

parameters.name: can-status
parameters.brief: CAN link: state | refused << 8 | dropped << 16.

parameters.name: raw-faults
parameters.brief: Raw Safety fault bits.

parameters.name: can-protocol
parameters.brief: CAN protocol: 0 CANSimple, 1 MIT; applies at once (DISABLED only).

parameters.name: mit-p-max
parameters.brief: MIT: position range +/-P_MAX, output side, relative to the output zero.

parameters.name: mit-v-max
parameters.brief: MIT: velocity range +/-V_MAX, output side.

parameters.name: mit-t-max
parameters.brief: MIT: feedforward and reply torque range +/-T_MAX, output side.

parameters.name: mit-kp-max
parameters.brief: MIT: stiffness range 0..KP_MAX, output side.

parameters.name: mit-kd-max
parameters.brief: MIT: damping range 0..KD_MAX, output side.

parameters.name: mit-reply-format
parameters.brief: MIT reply: 0 original 6 bytes (ID, p, v, t), 1 DaMiao 8 bytes (error|ID, p, v, t, 0, 0).

parameters.name: thermal-tau
parameters.brief: I2t winding time constant, 0 off or 1..3600; with ID 96 folds the current back to it.

parameters.name: i2t-load
parameters.brief: I2t state: 1 folds the current back to ID 96, 1.25 latches OVERLOAD.

parameters.name: thermal-current-limit
parameters.brief: Current-vector ceiling after the I2t fold-back and NTC derating.

parameters.name: fet-ntc-enable
parameters.brief: Power-stage NTC: 0 off, 1 on; on without a usable reading derates fully and trips.

parameters.name: fet-derate-temp
parameters.brief: Power-stage NTC: linear current derating starts here; below ID 140.

parameters.name: fet-limit-temp
parameters.brief: Power-stage NTC: zero current here; trips 5 C above, releases below it.

parameters.name: motor-ntc-enable
parameters.brief: Motor NTC: 0 off, 1 on; on without a usable reading derates fully and trips.

parameters.name: motor-derate-temp
parameters.brief: Motor NTC: linear current derating starts here; below ID 143.

parameters.name: motor-limit-temp
parameters.brief: Motor NTC: zero current here; trips 5 C above, releases below it.

parameters.name: ntc-beta
parameters.brief: NTC beta of both channels.

parameters.name: ntc-r25
parameters.brief: NTC resistance at 25 C.

parameters.name: ntc-pullup
parameters.brief: Fixed divider resistor of the NTC channels.

parameters.name: motor-temperature
parameters.brief: Filtered motor NTC temperature; NaN when off or without a reading.

parameters.name: ntc-topology
parameters.brief: NTC divider: 0 NTC to ground with pull-up, 1 NTC to the reference with pull-down.
